description: The chatmcp verify command line of Proof-of-Done (plan task pod-24, docs/PROOF-CLI.md): the grammar and its refusals, the words after -- for bash and PowerShell, the exit code of each answer, the JSON envelope and the human output, the state folder rules, the session checks, what each command wires and writes, the baseline store side of the check-changes report (lib/proof/cli/, bin/chatmcp.mjs) and the final tree of diffBaseline (lib/proof/baseline.mjs), judged by tests/verify-proof-cli.mjs.

mutations.name: PC-lang-first
mutations.what: a usage error answers in English whatever --lang says

mutations.name: PC-value-is-option
mutations.what: an option takes the next option as its value

patches.old: if (i + 1 >= head.length || head[i + 1].startsWith('--')) throw stop('missing_value', { option: name });
patches.new: if (i + 1 >= head.length) throw stop('missing_value', { option: name });

mutations.name: PC-repeated
mutations.what: an option given twice is taken, the last one wins

patches.old: if (Object.hasOwn(options, name)) throw stop('repeated_option', { option: name });

mutations.name: PC-flag-value
mutations.what: a flag given a value (--print=1) is taken as the flag

patches.old: if (equals > 0) throw stop('bad_value', { option: name, value: token.slice(equals + 1), expected: 'no value (a flag)' });

mutations.name: PC-lang-values
mutations.what: any --lang is accepted

mutations.name: PC-verify-word
mutations.what: the first word need not be verify

mutations.name: PC-unknown-command
mutations.what: a command that does not exist is looked up anyway

mutations.name: PC-not-built-grammar
mutations.what: check gets the grammar of the built commands

patches.old: if (Object.hasOwn(NOT_BUILT, command)) return { ...base, command, topic: null, options: {}, words };

mutations.name: PC-unknown-option
mutations.what: an option no command knows is ignored

patches.old: if (unknown.length) throw stop('unknown_option', { option: unknown[0], command });

mutations.name: PC-foreign-option
mutations.what: an option of another command is ignored

patches.old: if (foreign) throw stop('unknown_option', { option: foreign, command });

mutations.name: PC-extra-word
mutations.what: one word after the command is ignored

mutations.name: PC-dashes-not-run
mutations.what: -- is taken by a command other than run and exec

mutations.name: PC-sha256-shape
mutations.what: --sha256 takes any text

mutations.name: PC-sha256-case
mutations.what: --sha256 in capitals does not name the file

mutations.name: PC-shell-values
mutations.what: --shell takes any name

mutations.name: PC-timeout-low
mutations.what: --timeout 0 is accepted

mutations.name: PC-timeout-high
mutations.what: --timeout above 900 seconds is accepted

mutations.name: PC-run-needs-words
mutations.what: run without a command after -- goes on

mutations.name: PC-agent-value
mutations.what: --agent takes an empty name

mutations.name: PC-agent-default
mutations.what: the agent of a pack is DatGold unless named

mutations.name: PC-one-word
mutations.what: one word after -- is quoted like several

mutations.name: PC-posix-quote
mutations.what: a single quote inside a word is not escaped for bash

mutations.name: PC-posix-safe-space
mutations.what: a word with a space is not quoted for bash

mutations.name: PC-ps-safe-comma
mutations.what: a comma (PowerShell's array operator) is not quoted for PowerShell

mutations.name: PC-ps-curly-quotes
mutations.what: the curly quotes PowerShell reads as single quotes are not doubled

mutations.name: PC-ps-empty
mutations.what: an empty word goes to PowerShell, which drops it

patches.old: if (word === '') throw stop('unsafe_argument', { argument: word, shell: 'powershell', why: 'empty' });

mutations.name: PC-ps-double-quote
mutations.what: a word holding a double quote goes to PowerShell 5.1

mutations.name: PC-ps-stop-parsing
mutations.what: the word --% goes to PowerShell, which drops it

mutations.name: PC-ps-trailing-backslash
mutations.what: only a space counts as white space before a trailing backslash

mutations.name: PC-quote-choice
mutations.what: words for PowerShell are quoted the bash way

mutations.name: PC-code-not-built
mutations.what: not_built is a usage error

mutations.name: PC-code-check-failed
mutations.what: a failed check is a pass

mutations.name: PC-code-sha256-mismatch
mutations.what: another digest than the file's is only unverified

mutations.name: PC-exit-integrity
mutations.what: an integrity failure exits 1

mutations.name: PC-planned-check
mutations.what: check names the wrong plan task

mutations.name: PC-message-lang
mutations.what: every message is in English

mutations.name: PC-usage-lang
mutations.what: the help is in English whatever --lang says

mutations.name: PC-schema-code
mutations.what: the schema leaves out an answer code

mutations.name: PC-schema-passed
mutations.what: the run schema only allows passed receipts

mutations.name: PC-state-workspace-inside
mutations.what: a workspace inside the state folder is not refused

mutations.name: PC-state-inside-workspace
mutations.what: a state folder inside the workspace is not refused

mutations.name: PC-acceptance-outside
mutations.what: a link out of the workspace is an unexpected error, not acceptance_outside

mutations.name: PC-acceptance-not-file
mutations.what: a folder named acceptance.yml is read as a file

mutations.name: PC-torn-for-all

mutations.name: PC-torn-for-none
mutations.what: run refuses a torn ledger instead of letting the ledger repair it

mutations.name: PC-session-file
mutations.what: session.json is not checked against its own task id

mutations.what: the ledger's task_start is not checked against the session

mutations.name: PC-session-copy
mutations.what: the session's copy of the acceptance file is not hashed again

mutations.name: PC-init-exists
mutations.what: init --print proposes over an existing file

mutations.name: PC-init-print
mutations.what: init --print writes the file

patches.old: if (ctx.args.options.print) return { code: 'acceptance_printed', data, params, stdout: proposal.text, quiet: true };

mutations.name: PC-trust-mismatch
mutations.what: trust --sha256 trusts whatever digest is given

patches.old: if (asked !== sha256) throw stop('sha256_mismatch', { expected: asked, actual: sha256 });

mutations.name: PC-trust-revoked
mutations.what: a revoke that removed nothing says revoked

mutations.name: PC-trust-preview
mutations.what: the preview of a trusted file says not trusted

mutations.name: PC-trust-command
mutations.what: the preview's command does not name the digest

mutations.name: PC-snapshot-copy
mutations.what: snapshot keeps no copy of the acceptance file

mutations.name: PC-snapshot-anchor
mutations.what: the task_start holds another anchor than the baseline's

patches.old: format: SESSION_FORMAT, source, baselineId: base.id, baselineSha256: base.sha256,
patches.new: format: SESSION_FORMAT, source, baselineId: base.id, baselineSha256: 'f'.repeat(64),

mutations.name: PC-snapshot-pointer
mutations.what: snapshot does not make its session the current one

patches.old: await writeSession(state, { taskId, baselineId: base.id, root, startedAt: record.createdAt });

mutations.name: PC-snapshot-trusted
mutations.what: snapshot never says the acceptance file is trusted

mutations.name: PC-passed-exit
mutations.what: a receipt passes whatever its exit code

mutations.name: PC-run-passed
mutations.what: run calls every check passed

mutations.name: PC-run-cwd-folder
mutations.what: run --cwd naming a file goes to the shell

patches.old: if (!(await fs.stat(cwd.absolute).catch(() => null))?.isDirectory()) throw stop('bad_cwd', { cwd: options.cwd });

mutations.name: PC-run-snapshotter
mutations.what: a receipt records no tree

patches.old: await recordCheck({ ledger, runner, snapshotter, toolchain,
patches.new: await recordCheck({ ledger, runner, snapshotter: null, toolchain,

mutations.name: PC-anchor
mutations.what: show and pack read the baseline without the anchor (the diff's own anchor removed too)

patches.old: loadBaseline({ hubDir: state.hubDir, root, id: loaded.baselineId, expectSha256: loaded.anchor });
patches.new: loadBaseline({ hubDir: state.hubDir, root, id: loaded.baselineId, expectSha256: null });

patches.old: diffBaseline({ hubDir: state.hubDir, root, id: loaded.baselineId, expectSha256: loaded.anchor, env: ctx.env });
patches.new: diffBaseline({ hubDir: state.hubDir, root, id: loaded.baselineId, expectSha256: null, env: ctx.env });

mutations.name: PC-pack-patch
mutations.what: pack goes on without a patch

mutations.name: PC-pack-patch-reason
mutations.what: every missing patch is baseline_objects_missing

mutations.name: PC-pack-criteria-now
mutations.what: the criteria of a pack come from the acceptance file on disk now

patches.new: acceptance = await resolveAcceptance({ baseline: current.state === 'present' ? current.bytes : null,

mutations.name: PC-pack-detector-criteria

patches.old: baseCommit: typeof record.git?.head === 'string' && GIT_ID.test(record.git.head) ? record.git.head : null,

mutations.name: PC-not-built-task

mutations.name: PC-json-detect
mutations.what: a usage error does not answer in JSON

mutations.what: an edited baseline is an unexpected error
